messages.subject: [IT] DMS maintenance window - Saturday 24 May 22:00-02:00
messages.plaintextBody:
Colleagues,

The document management system (NetDocs) will be unavailable this Saturday 24 May from 22:00 to 02:00 for scheduled maintenance and indexing. Please save and check in any open documents before 21:30. Email and calendar are unaffected.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
